No cut-out halos, mismatched blur, cloned repetition, smeared patches or seams are visible; light direction, haze and grain are consistent across the three cattle heads and the misty background. However the heavily darkened upper-left corner and the near-black right-hand animal conceal detail, so the absence of tampering cannot be fully affirmed by eye.

notes: No referenced regions and no named objects. Image A is a low-angle monochrome shot of a pale calf facing the lens, a grey cow nuzzling it and a dark cow at the right edge, in misty pasture. The single image-checkable claim is broadly consistent with what is visible, with dark areas limiting certainty.
